{{Infobox auto}}
'''Natural Lapis Lazuli''' is the renamed deepslate lapis lazuli ore.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
The deepslate part of the [[Quartz Deposit|quartz deposit]] feature, plus the vanilla buried lapis veins.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 4–9 lapis lazuli (vanilla table). Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/deepslate_lapis_ore.json}}</ref>
